target: सूती कपड़े की कमीज़ गर्मी में आरामदायक होती है।
english: A cotton shirt is comfortable in summer.
reason: "टाट का बिछौना" (jute mat) is niche village trivia a learner will never say, and the sentence reads like an encyclopaedia entry. Replacement keeps the same का/की genitive + generic होता/होती है pattern with everyday clothing vocabulary.

target: यह दवा पेट दर्द में आराम देती है।
english: This medicine gives relief for stomach pain.
reason: Home-remedy trivia in written register ("अजवाइन ... राहत देती है"); nobody states it as a fact like this in conversation. Replacement keeps the same feminine subject + simple-present देती है structure in a situation a learner actually needs (pharmacy, illness).

target: मेरी माँ अपने गाँव को बहुत याद करती हैं।
english: My mother misses her village very much.
reason: "ननिहाल की याद करती हैं" is ungrammatical collocation – it is either X को याद करना or X की याद आना – and ननिहाल is niche vocabulary. Replacement keeps the अपना reflexive possessive with the correct को याद करना pattern.

target: रसोई में खाना बन रहा था।
english: Food was being cooked in the kitchen.
reason: Potter's-wheel scene is decorative village imagery, not language a learner will use. Replacement keeps the identical past-continuous बन रहा था structure with a location phrase, in an everyday setting.

target: स्कूल में हर साल परीक्षा होती है।
english: Exams are held every year at school.
reason: Census facts are officialese trivia. Replacement keeps the same हर + time-period + होती है habitual pattern with content a learner can reuse.

target: पहले मैं रोज़ सुबह टहलने जाता था।
english: Earlier I used to go for a walk every morning.
reason: Near word-for-word duplicate of hi-1573 ("पहले गाँवों में बिजली नहीं होती थी") – pure padding, and this batch is already heavy with old-days nostalgia. Replacement keeps the habitual past जाता था in a personal, everyday frame.

target: यह चिट्ठी पोस्ट ऑफिस में डाल दो।
english: Drop this letter off at the post office.
reason: "चिट्ठी जमा कर दो" is the wrong collocation and bureaucratic register – you post a letter (डालना), you do not submit it. Same imperative + compound-verb structure, corrected verb.

target: टीचर ने ब्लैकबोर्ड पर सवाल लिखा।
english: The teacher wrote the question on the blackboard.
reason: Fronting the location before the subject ("ब्लैकबोर्ड पर टीचर ने...") is marked, stilted word order, and सूत्र (formula) is niche school vocabulary. Replacement keeps the ने-perfective with neutral word order and a common noun.

target: बॉस ने मेरी छुट्टी मंज़ूर कर दी।
reason: Institutional officialese ("फैकल्टी ने नए कोर्स को मंज़ूरी दी") that a learner will never say. Replacement keeps the ने-perfective and the same मंज़ूर vocabulary in a situation people actually talk about.

target: मेरी बहन ने सबके लिए चाय बनाई।
english: My sister made tea for everyone.
reason: Storybook flourish ("cheerful girl won everyone's heart") with the literary word ख़ुशमिज़ाज – decorative, not usable. Replacement keeps the ने-perfective with feminine object agreement in ordinary everyday content.
